verdict.rationale: Moneybird is a SaaS bookkeeping and invoicing service, so letting users choose where their data is stored is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data region, residency, hosting location or any storage-location choice. The pack covers authentication, API endpoints, MCP, webhooks, sandboxes, versioning and product features, none of which is about this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
